players.product: 300mm poly-silicon and metal dry etchers (Leo / Nardo-M series)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 161,185,514,627 (H1 2025: KRW 57,117,530,167) and operating profit KRW 50,197,828,620; Q2 2026 revenue KRW 72,292,819,990 (Q2 2025: KRW 39,209,331,210) and operating profit KRW 20,054,641,807. Domestic sales KRW 138,985M (86.23%), exports KRW 22,201M (13.77%)

Customer concentration (customers not named in the note): Customer A KRW 138,973,859,500 and Customer B KRW 22,200,935,127 of H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: KRW 54,453,046,743 and KRW 2,664,483,424); the report says its main customer is SK hynix, sold directly
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A KRW 138,973,859,500; Customer B KRW 22,200,935,127

quarterly_data.signal: Third-generation poly etcher Leo WS: in-house process tests completed in H1 2025 and customer-led hardware performance and process evaluation completed in H2 2025; the customer JDP schedule is confirmed for 2026 with set-up under way (fab-in in July, then JDP). The upgraded Leo WSA is under customer process evaluation, and oxide etchers (Da Vinci WH for high-aspect-ratio, Mona Lisa WH) and an atomic-layer etcher (APES) are in development
